annotations.title: Change the files of a website builder draft

description: Use this when someone asks to change their website builder draft: its wording, colours, layout or sections. Returns the new checkpoint, which saves every file given as one change that restore_website_checkpoint can undo; the dentist sees the draft in the app's website builder. Not for the settings of the public site.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file, never a part

path.description: Path in the website, such as src/copy.js

message.description: What changed, in the owner's words, such as Moved the reviews above the services. It names the checkpoint in the builder.

parentCheckpoint.description: The checkpoint read_website_files read the files at. The change is refused when the website changed since.

name: write_website_files

checkpoint.description: The new checkpoint; null when every file was already as given

title: Change the files of a website builder draft
